page_title: LIV 4-3 FUL | Liverpool v Fulham 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+3' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) picks out Darwin Nunez with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Harrison Reed and he is replaced by Carlos Vinicius (Fulham).
88' 4 - 3 Goal! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is teed up on the edge of the box by Konstantinos Tsimikas, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 4:3.
87' 3 - 3 Goal! Mohamed Salah tees up Wataru Endo (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top right corner. 3:3.
85' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
85' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
85' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will deliver the corner kick.
84' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
83' That's the end of the game for Ryan Gravenberch, who is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
83' The cross into the penalty area from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

80' 2 - 3 Tom Cairney displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the top right corner – 2:3.
78' A perfect long pass by Tom Cairney (Fulham) finds Willian. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
75' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Kenny Tete is replaced by Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Iwobi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
75' Willian (Fulham) sprays a pass out to Tom Cairney, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
74' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Trent Alexander-Arnold, but Bernd Leno displays great awareness to stop him.
73' A crossfield pass from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates.
72' Mohamed Salah almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
69' Jurgen Klopp is forced to make a change. Joel Matip is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
67' Joel Matip (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' Here comes a substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Mac Allister.
64' Here comes a substitution. Dominik Szoboszlai is given a rest as he is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Willian (Fulham).
62' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Harry Wilson will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
61' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) does well to meet a cross from Mohamed Salah, but he directs his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
60' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
59' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker.
58' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.
57' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
55' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Bernd Leno.
54' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
53' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno is alert and makes a decent save.

52' It looked like the long-range shot by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
52' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

51' What a great touch by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
49' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
49' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Fulham.
48' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+12' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+12' He should have scored! Harrison Reed (Fulham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.

45+10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45+8' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Tim Ream (Fulham) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+8' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45+4' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Stuart Attwell to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Fulham players can finally celebrate.
45+4' The Fulham players halt their celebrations as referee Stuart Attwell makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' 2 - 2 Kenny Tete (Fulham) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
45+3' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45+2' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. It will be a corner kick for Fulham.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' We will have 9 min. of added time.
45' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) plays a one-two with Mohamed Salah, but the move breaks down.
42' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

38' 2 - 1 Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 2:1 with this magnificent strike.
38' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

35' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
35' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

34' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
34' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

33' That's unlucky! Antonee Robinson (Fulham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
31' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) plays a long ball to Luis Diaz, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.

30' What an opportunity! Joel Matip (Liverpool) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
29' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Calvin Bassey (Fulham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
24' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Antonee Robinson picks out Harry Wilson (Fulham) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:1.
23' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

20' 1 - 0 Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot. Bernd Leno (Fulham) scores an own goal! No one would like to be in his position right now.
18' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joao Palhinha (Fulham) brought his opponent down. Liverpool are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
16' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bernd Leno is quickest to intercept the ball.
14' Bernd Leno (Fulham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' Bernd Leno (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' A goal, which was scored by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), was disallowed due to offside.

9' A sweet pass finds Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.

6' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The ball has crossed the sideline. Liverpool are taking a throw-in.
5' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) plays a terrific long ball forward to Mohamed Salah, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
2' A pass from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is intercepted by Caoimhin Kelleher and the move breaks down.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stuart Attwell.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
